title: Baseball
text:
Baseball Through the Data
This site uses the Lahman database to explore Major League Baseball history through its data. Comparing home runs per team-game, rather than raw totals, puts shortened seasons in context and makes it easier to follow the changing home-run trend across eras.
Barry Bonds leads the career list with 762 home runs. Visit the Home runs and Sluggers pages in the navbar to explore the seasonal trend, career leaders, and Bonds’ home runs by season.
